subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@finservco.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@finservco.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan

Hi Amanda / Raj —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our demo and a proposed POC plan to validate Redwood for your chatbot use case. I attached a short evaluation plan (PDF) and a roles spreadsheet.

Demo recap (high level):
- Goal: embed a compliant LLM-based assistant into FinServCo’s customer support flow for common billing/account questions.
- Primary constraints: PII/data residency in US, SLA for <500ms 95th percentile, and audit logs for regulatory review.
- Demo showed: model routing (fast vs high-quality), prefix caching for repeated queries, and per-route cost/latency dashboards.

Proposed POC — outline (attached: Redwood_POC_Eval_Plan_20260610.pdf):
1) Success criteria (what we will measure):
   - Accuracy: >= 85% helpful/accurate responses on the curated 200-case eval set
   - Latency: 95th percentile inference latency < 500ms under expected traffic (burst to 20 rps)
   - Cost: token cost projection within 20% of target budget (TBD)
   - Compliance: logs and retention meet your audit checklist (SOC2 evidence to be provided)
2) Evaluation plan:
   - Week 0: kickoff, access/provisioning, sample data format confirmed
   - Week 1: integration & initial config (models, routing, quantization recommendations)
   - Week 2: run test harness against 200-case eval set + collect metrics
   - Week 3: tune model routing, caching, and thresholds; finalize pass/fail assessment
3) Timeline: 3-week POC (target kickoff week of Jun 15 — flexible)
4) Ownership & points of contact:
   - FinServCo POC lead: Amanda Lee (you)
   - Redwood POC lead: Marissa Cole (marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com)
   - Redwood SE: Markus Klein (markus.klein@redwoodinference.com)
   - CS/rollout: Lauren Bishop (lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com)
5) Deliverables:
   - Temporary API key + example client + test harness
   - Dashboard access (latency, cost, token breakdown)
   - Final POC report with pass/fail and recommended production configuration

Next steps / asks for you:
- Please confirm the success criteria above (especially the eval set size and the latency target).
- Confirm preferred kickoff week (Jun 15 vs Jun 22).
- Share a sample of expected user queries (anonymized) and any notes on redaction/residency requirements.

I attached the short evaluation plan and a roles sheet. I can also share SOC2 evidence + security whitepaper via the shared Drive link if you need that for procurement.

Looking forward —

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan

Thanks Marissa — really helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side before we lock dates:

1) Data residency: all logs and any retained PII must remain in the US. Is that supported in the POC (we may be in a restricted environment)?
2) Eval set size: 200 sounds good but can we expand to 300 if it makes the accuracy signal stronger?
3) Latency target: 500ms 95th is aggressive — can you confirm this includes network time from our app to the hosted region (we run in us-east-1)?
4) Procurement: we will need SOC2 Type II evidence and a short security questionnaire filled. Can you drop the docs to a secure Drive?

On timing — our internal calendar looks tight the week of Jun 15. Would you be able to start the kickoff the week of Jun 22 instead? That gives us until Friday to prepare the sample queries and data access.

If you can confirm residency, expand the eval set to 300, and shift kickoff to Jun 22, we can move forward.

Best,
Amanda
Head of Digital Channels | FinServCo
Amanda.Lee@finservco.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@finservco.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@finservco.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan

Hi Amanda — great questions, and yes we can accommodate those adjustments. See notes inline below.

> Data residency: all logs and any retained PII must remain in the US. Is that supported in the POC?
Yes — we can pin the POC to us-east-1 with customer-controlled retention settings. We'll also provide a config that avoids persistent KV storage for any PII and will show how logs are retained/rotated.

> Eval set size: 200 sounds good but can we expand to 300?
Absolutely — expanding to 300 is straightforward. We'll run the harness against the full set; it just shifts a bit more compute/time but still fits in the 3-week window.

> Latency target: 500ms 95th — does this include network time from our app?
The 500ms target in our plan is the end-to-end inference time from when our API receives the request to when we return the first token. It does not include your internal network time; we typically add a small network estimate for planning. For us-east-1 hosting we expect the 95th to be ~350–450ms for the sample workload, but we'll validate during the first test run.

> Procurement: SOC2 + questionnaire
I'll upload the SOC2 summary and our security whitepaper to the Drive link and share it with your procurement team.

Updated plan based on your asks:
- Eval set: 300 cases
- Kickoff: Week of Jun 22 (target Mon Jun 22)
- POC kickoff duration: 60 min runbook walk-through
- Owners: Amanda (FinServCo), Marissa (Redwood lead), Markus (SE), Lauren (CS)

Next actions from Redwood (I'll do these today):
- Share Drive folder with SOC2 + security docs: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRedwood-FinServ-POC
- Provide temporary API key + example client + test harness by Mon Jun 15 for early review
- Schedule kickoff for Mon Jun 22 at 10:00am ET — please confirm if that works for your team

If that timing works, I'll send a calendar invite and drop the API key into a secure place for your engineering team.

Cheers,
Marissa
